cases.purpose: Send and receive deterministic binary bytes across two 16384-byte boundaries.
cases.setup_script: /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import hashlib,os; a=bytes((i*73+19)%256 for i in range(32768+45)); b=bytes((i*37+11)%256 for i in range(16384)); assert len(a)==32813 and len(b)==16384 and 0 in a and max(a)>127; assert hashlib.sha256(a).hexdigest()=="d5b60ff71ffd82d71e5cda06bb82482785283d64a95c7144049a61ed1d96cdb9" and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()=="ce61cc72a84bd3526a8f955235c5f4f67439820d6ffb910b5ab07e54741262b8"; m,s=os.openpty(); assert os.isatty(m) and os.isatty(s); os.close(m); os.close(s)'
cases.oracle: Documented broker contract, independently created fixed bytes and Linux PTY/process observations. Setup controls the PTY facility and exact expected byte hashes; no candidate output defines expected behavior.
cases.comparison: Check exact send counts including EOF, contiguous output event offsets, byte equality for both echoed output and independently recorded child input, and cleanup.
cases.script:
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/terminal-review112-pty-broker-r2-c4f9e09f956d.py
root=$HOME/broker-root
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" prepare || exit 1
/usr/bin/mkdir -m 700 "$root" || exit 1
failed=0
mark() { if [[ $2 == 1 ]]; then printf '%s=PASS\n' "$1"; else printf '%s=FAIL\n' "$1"; failed=1; fi; }
await_file() { local j; for ((j=0;j<100;j++)); do [[ -f $HOME/$1 ]] && return 0; /usr/bin/sleep .05; done; return 1; }
trap 'ptybroker terminate "$root" one >/dev/null 2>&1 || :' EXIT

ptybroker create "$root" one -- /usr/bin/python3 "$H" child binary >"$HOME/create.log" 2>"$HOME/errors.log" || exit 1
await_file binary-ready || exit 1
ptybroker attach "$root" one observe h 2>>"$HOME/errors.log" || exit 1
exec 8>"$HOME/received-binary"
ptybroker receive "$h" 8 ev 3000 2>>"$HOME/errors.log" || exit 1
[[ $ev == attached\ * ]] || exit 1
exec 7<"$HOME/expected-binary"
ptybroker send-fd "$root" one 7 n1 2>>"$HOME/errors.log"; r1=$?
ptybroker send-fd "$root" one 7 n2 2>>"$HOME/errors.log"; r2=$?
ptybroker send-fd "$root" one 7 n3 2>>"$HOME/errors.log"; r3=$?
ptybroker send-fd "$root" one 7 n4 2>>"$HOME/errors.log"; r4=$?
printf '%s %s %s %s | %s %s %s %s\n' "$n1" "$n2" "$n3" "$n4" "$r1" "$r2" "$r3" "$r4" >"$HOME/counts.log"
good=0; [[ $r1 == 0 && $r2 == 0 && $r3 == 0 && $r4 == 0 && $n1 == 16384 && $n2 == 16384 && $n3 == 45 && $n4 == 0 ]] && good=1
mark send-fd-counts "$good"
total=0; offsets=1
for ((i=0;i<128 && total<32813;i++)); do
  ptybroker receive "$h" 8 ev 1500 2>>"$HOME/errors.log" || { offsets=0; break; }
  printf '%s\n' "$ev" >>"$HOME/events.log"
  if [[ $ev =~ ^output[[:space:]]size=([0-9]+)[[:space:]]offset=([0-9]+)$ ]]; then
    n=${BASH_REMATCH[1]}; off=${BASH_REMATCH[2]}; (( off == total && n > 0 )) || offsets=0; ((total+=n))
  else offsets=0; break; fi
done
exec 8>&- 7<&-
good=0; ((offsets == 1 && total == 32813)) && good=1
mark continuous-offsets "$good"
good=0; /usr/bin/cmp -s "$HOME/expected-binary" "$HOME/received-binary" && good=1
mark roundtrip-bytes "$good"
good=0; await_file binary-child-input && /usr/bin/cmp -s "$HOME/expected-binary" "$HOME/binary-child-input" && good=1
mark child-received-bytes "$good"
ptybroker terminate "$root" one 2>>"$HOME/errors.log"; rc=$?
good=0; [[ $rc == 0 && ! -e $root/one ]] && good=1
mark cleanup "$good"
exit "$failed"

cases.purpose: Check initial child winsize, resize SIGWINCH, and the attached geometry event.
cases.setup_script: /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import hashlib,os; a=bytes((i*73+19)%256 for i in range(32768+45)); b=bytes((i*37+11)%256 for i in range(16384)); assert len(a)==32813 and len(b)==16384 and 0 in a and max(a)>127; assert hashlib.sha256(a).hexdigest()=="d5b60ff71ffd82d71e5cda06bb82482785283d64a95c7144049a61ed1d96cdb9" and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()=="ce61cc72a84bd3526a8f955235c5f4f67439820d6ffb910b5ab07e54741262b8"; m,s=os.openpty(); assert os.isatty(m) and os.isatty(s); os.close(m); os.close(s)'
cases.oracle: Documented broker contract, independently created fixed bytes and Linux PTY/process observations. Setup controls the PTY facility and exact expected byte hashes; no candidate output defines expected behavior.
cases.comparison: The fixed child reads TIOCGWINSZ before resize and inside its SIGWINCH handler; the observer separately checks the geometry event and service cleanup.
cases.script:
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/terminal-review112-pty-broker-r2-c4f9e09f956d.py
root=$HOME/broker-root
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" prepare || exit 1
/usr/bin/mkdir -m 700 "$root" || exit 1
failed=0
mark() { if [[ $2 == 1 ]]; then printf '%s=PASS\n' "$1"; else printf '%s=FAIL\n' "$1"; failed=1; fi; }
await_file() { local j; for ((j=0;j<100;j++)); do [[ -f $HOME/$1 ]] && return 0; /usr/bin/sleep .05; done; return 1; }
trap 'ptybroker terminate "$root" one >/dev/null 2>&1 || :' EXIT

ptybroker create "$root" one --rows 31 --cols 97 -- /usr/bin/python3 "$H" child geometry >"$HOME/create.log" 2>"$HOME/errors.log" || exit 1
await_file geometry-initial || exit 1
initial=$(<"$HOME/geometry-initial")
good=0; [[ $initial == '31 97' ]] && good=1
mark initial-child-size "$good"
ptybroker attach "$root" one observe h 2>>"$HOME/errors.log" || exit 1
exec 8>"$HOME/output"
ptybroker receive "$h" 8 ev 3000 2>>"$HOME/errors.log" || exit 1
[[ $ev == attached\ * ]] || exit 1
ptybroker resize "$root" one 37 119 2>>"$HOME/errors.log"; resize_rc=$?
ptybroker receive "$h" 8 ev 3000 2>>"$HOME/errors.log"; event_rc=$?
printf '%s\n' "$ev" >"$HOME/geometry-event.log"
good=0; [[ $resize_rc == 0 && $event_rc == 0 && $ev == 'geometry rows=37 cols=119 '* ]] && good=1
mark resize-event "$good"
good=0; if await_file geometry-winch; then value=$(<"$HOME/geometry-winch"); [[ $value == '37 119' ]] && good=1; fi
mark signal-and-child-size "$good"
ptybroker terminate "$root" one 2>>"$HOME/errors.log"; rc=$?
good=0; [[ $rc == 0 && ! -e $root/one ]] && good=1
mark cleanup "$good"
exit "$failed"
